E1.evidence:
PR #286 (davetcoleman, "Fixup for MoveIt! Kinetic") states "Fixes https://github.com/ros-planning/moveit/pull/361 among other things" and changes ur_kinematics' #include <moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo.h> to #include <moveit_msgs/KinematicSolverInfo.h>; maintainer shaun-edwards merged it ("+1..
Thanks for the contribution....merging."). moveit_msgs commit 2f3f97b removed srv/GetKinematicSolverInfo.srv (moveit_msgs issue #3: "It is only used by pr2_arm_kinematics and nobody calls it.").

E2.evidence: ur_kinematics' ur_moveit_plugin.h includes the generated header of the service definition moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo (to obtain moveit_msgs::KinematicSolverInfo); moveit_msgs removed srv/GetKinematicSolverInfo.srv on kinetic-devel (2f3f97b, merged via moveit_msgs PR #35 on 2016-11-17), so the referenced definition no longer exists. The consumer must follow the provider's removal; the fix changes the consumer's reference, not only build configuration.

E3.evidence: UPGRADE: ur_kinematics (release 1.1.9) still references a moveit_msgs definition as it existed before 2f3f97b, built against MoveIt Kinetic sources after the removal (PR title "Fixup for MoveIt! Kinetic").

E4.evidence: Code-level statement of the mismatch in the merged fix: "-#include <moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo.h>" / "+#include <moveit_msgs/KinematicSolverInfo.h>", mirroring MoveIt PR #361 ("``GetKinematicSolverInfo`` is no longer used. Here I replace an inappropriate dependency with the message ``KinematicSolverInfo``"). No build log is shown.

resolution.summary: In ur_kinematics/include/ur_kinematics/ur_moveit_plugin.h include <moveit_msgs/KinematicSolverInfo.h> instead of the removed service header <moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo.h>.

notes: Composition choice departs from the packet title. PR #286 fixes three things in ur_kinematics: (1) the moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo include (the one the reporter names: "Fixes https://github.com/ros-planning/moveit/pull/361 among other things"), (2) add_compile_options(-std=c++11), and (3) catkin_package DEPENDS boost -> Boost. Following the rule to specify the composition the reporter names, this spec covers moveit_msgs/ur_kinematics. The packet's bug title ("required C++11 compiler") refers to (2): geometric_shapes PR #51 (merge ba21fbf7, 2016-08-16) added to include/geometric_shapes/shapes.h "#if __cplusplus <= 199711L\n#error This header requires at least C++11\n#endif" (and in shape_messages.h "#error This header requires at least C++11 (boost::variant is incompatible between c++98 and c++11 and we enforce 11)"), which ur_kinematics reaches through MoveIt headers; its resolving change in ur_kinematics is a compiler flag only, so that composition would stop at E2 step 4 (build). (3) is a build-system change. Element naming: the service type is written as msg:moveit_msgs/GetKinematicSolverInfo (definition type) for lack of a canonical srv-type form. consumer_built_against.broken is the moveit_msgs kinetic-devel parent of the removal commit (280ec03b, still containing srv/GetKinematicSolverInfo.srv); resolved is the kinetic-devel head the fix was written for.
